info.title: TrustFlow API
info.description:
AI-powered Business Operating System for SMBs.

Authentication: obtain an access token from POST /auth/login (or /auth/register) and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Money: invoices, payments and receipts use integer kobo (JSON numbers). Orders, order items and products use decimal naira strings (e.g. "1000.00"). See the frontend integration notes.

permissions.description: Every permission the server grants this role

refreshTokenHash.description:
Hash of the current valid refresh token, enabling rotation
(each successful refresh replaces this with a new hash) and
revocation (logout / suspected theft sets this to null,
invalidating the refresh token immediately even though the JWT
itself hasn't expired yet). Never returned via the API.

previousRefreshTokenHash.description:
Hash of the refresh token that was valid immediately before the
most recent rotation, paired with refreshTokenRotatedAt. Lets a
concurrent refresh() call that lost the compare-and-swap race be
told "already rotated" instead of having its session wiped as
theft. Cleared on logout and fresh login/register.

displacedRefreshTokenHash.description:
Hash of the refresh token that was valid immediately before the
most recent login() replaced it — paired with displacedAt.
TrustFlow permits one active refresh-token session per user; a
successful login from another device replaces the existing
session rather than coexisting with it. This lets the displaced
device's next refresh() attempt be told SESSION_REPLACED_BY_NEW_LOGIN
instead of being treated as generic token theft. Unlike
previousRefreshTokenHash/refreshTokenRotatedAt (a short CAS-race
grace window), this has no expiry — a displaced device may not
attempt to refresh for hours or days. Cleared on logout.
